Home.headline: Speak like a CEO.
Home.sub: Train clarity, structure, and authority — 5 to 20 minutes a day.

hero.title: Speak the way they listen in the boardroom
hero.sub: From mental draft to clear delivery — 5 to 20 minutes a day.

beforeAfter.title: From haze to a line that cuts
beforeAfter.sub: Same idea. Different level of authority.
beforeAfter.beforeText: Uh so basically I think our priority this quarter is actually to accelerate acquisition. We're a bit behind but you know we'll try to catch up.
beforeAfter.afterText: Our #1 priority this quarter: accelerate acquisition. We're closing a pipeline gap with three levers — targeted outbound, partnerships, and a shorter sales cycle.

method.title: A four-step method
method.sub: One clear question, a timed exercise, immediate feedback.

1.title: Diagnose
1.body: Goal, fears, pace: a 30-day plan calibrated to you.

2.title: Practice
2.body: Impromptu, pitch, board Q&A, storytelling — timer and camera.

3.title: Measure
3.body: Six axes, pace, fillers, C-level rewrites.

4.title: Lock in
4.body: Streak, progress, one actionable tip per session.

demo.title: Feedback like a coach in your pocket
demo.sub: Record. Get the version “as a CEO would have said it.”

1.quote: In board meetings I now lead with the conclusion. The questions changed tone.

2.quote: Fillers dropped. Silence became a tool, not a hole.

3.quote: The CEO rewrite showed the gap — and how to close it in ten minutes.

final.title: Move from draft to clarity
